verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own docs say it can load data from object storage and query directly from S3, GCS and Azure Blob Storage, with S3 credentials stored as a SECRET object, so the core ingestion path exists. The pack never names CSV, JSON or Parquet formats or shows a single bulk-load command. Missing for 10: explicit CSV/JSON/Parquet format support, a documented single-command bulk-load syntax, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can bulk-load CSV, JSON, and Parquet from cloud object storage with a single documented command

citations.quote: Load your data from other databases and object storage
Cloud Storage Integration: Query data directly from S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage, and more
You can safely store your Amazon S3 credentials in MotherDuck for convenience by creating a `SECRET` object
